title: Commission Implementing Regulation imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on cold-rolled steel imports from India, Japan, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam
dek: The European Commission has issued a regulation imposing definitive anti-dumping duties on cold-rolled steel imports from India, Japan, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam, EU Law Live reports.
summary: According to EU Law Live, the European Commission has adopted an implementing regulation imposing a definitive anti-dumping duty on cold-rolled steel imports from India, Japan, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam. The publisher did not provide an excerpt with rates for the other countries.
keyFacts: Definitive anti-dumping duty on cold-rolled steel imports
Countries named: India, Japan, Taiwan, Türkiye and Vietnam
whyItMatters: A definitive duty covering five supplying countries reshapes competitive conditions in the EU cold-rolled market. It adds to existing European trade defences on steel.
implications: EU buyers may face higher import costs or turn to domestic mills or non-targeted origins. Exporters in the five named countries could redirect volumes to other markets, adding to supply pressure elsewhere.
